description: This file defines providers, models, and logic related to quiz analytics within a Flutter application using Riverpod. It includes dependency providers, data models for filters and KPIs, and computed analytics functions for quiz attempts and categories.

classes.name: AnalyticsFilter
classes.description: Model representing filter criteria (start/end date and optional category) for analytics queries.

classes.name: QuizKpis
classes.description: Aggregator for key performance indicators such as total attempts, average score, best score, completion rate, and recent attempts count.

classes.name: PerQuizStat
classes.description: Stores statistics per quiz, including attempts, last/best/average scores, and completion flag.

classes.name: QuizAnalytics
classes.description: Container for overall KPIs and detailed per-quiz statistics.

classes.name: AnalyticsFilterNotifier
classes.description: State notifier managing current analytics filter; includes methods to set presets, custom ranges, and categories.

classes.name: QuizAnalyticsRefresher
classes.description: Notifier used to trigger refreshes of analytics data.

methods.name: _startOfDay
methods.description: Helper to calculate the start of the day (midnight UTC) for a given DateTime.

methods.name: _endOfDay
methods.description: Helper to calculate the end of the day (23:59:59.999 UTC) for a given DateTime.

methods.name: _within
methods.description: Checks if a DateTime is within a specified start and end range (inclusive).
